claim_verdicts.evidence: OrdersController.cs @stage-1: `[Authorize] [HttpPost] public async Task<ActionResult<OrderDto>> Create(CreateOrderRequest request)` with `var customerId = int.Parse(User.FindFirstValue(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub)!);`. claim_verdicts.evidence: Kind opinion, taken from outline misconception 2; phrased as a consequence for the user, not as a documented rule. The 401/400/500 mapping it relies on is verified under claim 4.

ASP.NET Core docs: "Calling `UseAuthentication` registers the middleware that uses the previously registered authentication schemes." and "An authentication challenge is invoked by Authorization when an unauthenticated user requests an endpoint that requires authentication." Example: "A JWT bearer scheme returning a 401 result with a `www-authenticate: bearer` header." Program.cs @stage-1: default scheme JwtBearer, `app.UseAuthentication(); app.UseAuthorization();` (70-71). Lab: no token -> 401.

RFC 9110 §9.2.2: "Of the request methods defined by this specification, PUT, DELETE, and safe request methods are idempotent." (POST is not listed). Lab 2026-09-26: two identical POST /api/v1/orders with the same token -> 201 id 31 and 201 id 32, both customerId 1.

issues.quote: `mounted` is the same check as on the login screen, so `setState` runs only while the screen is still in the widget tree.
issues.text: Unlisted claim (Flutter State behaviour, not in claims 12-13), and too broad for this code. Only the `finally` call is guarded (`if (mounted) setState(() => _loading = false);`); the two `setState` calls in `try` and `catch` (create_order_screen.dart:27,29) have no `mounted` check, so "`setState` runs only while the screen is still in the widget tree" is not true of this screen as a whole.
issues.fix: Replace with: "`if (mounted)` is the same check as on the login screen: this last `setState` runs only if the screen is still in the widget tree." Add a claim (kind behavior, version_key flutter, section 5): State.mounted is true while the State object is in the tree; only the finally setState in _placeOrder is guarded (create_order_screen.dart:27-31).
